incidentLearning.symptom: Initial PR #2078 had valid cockpit code but stale/invalid BRAIN admission metadata and then became behind moving main.
incidentLearning.rootCause: The first pull_request event snapshot was created before canonical delivery metadata was present; later connector pushes did not create a fresh pull_request synchronize run, and main moved while recovery was in progress.
incidentLearning.recovery: Close superseded PR #2078, reapply the exact four-file delta on current main, create recovery PR #2082 with complete delivery metadata, enable auto-merge, and verify exact production deploy identity.
prevention: Create complete delivery metadata before opening a protected PR when BRAIN admission consumes pull_request body.
Do not treat later PR-body edits as mutation of an already-created GitHub event snapshot.
If a candidate loses fresh synchronize semantics and main has moved, prefer one explicit superseding recovery candidate from current main rather than accumulating stale attempts.
Production is not proven by merge; require Netlify commit_ref/readback to match the protected merge identity.
